title: b7z9.36(c): C — capability-announce resource in coap_server + capability table
description: Child of b7z9.36. C coap_server resource for POST /.well-known/capability-announce with the capability table (256 LRU) and the same verification ordering, mirroring the tunnel_auth.c resource-registration pattern. Host tests under lichen/tests/.
close_reason: Landed the C capability-announce surface (spec 8.12). (1) Capability table: lichen_capability_table_{init,cached_seq,record,purge_expired} in capability_announce.c — bounded LRU (CONFIG_LICHEN_CAPABILITY_TABLE_CAPACITY, default 256), 25% egress reservation, monotone per-IID eviction seq-floor ledger, atomic_flag lock; mirrors Python CapabilityTable / Rust CapabilityTable semantics. (2) CoAP resource: POST /.well-known/capability-announce in coap_server.c behind CONFIG_LICHEN_CAPABILITY_ANNOUNCE, OSCORE-protected only (fail-closed 4.01 on plaintext), canonical pubkey-IID sender extraction reusing lichen_tunnel_sender_iid_from_sockaddr, handler callback (coap_server.h lichen_coap_capability_announce_cb + verdict) with 204/403/503 mapping pinned by BUILD_ASSERT (5.03=0xA3 corrected after Zephyr build caught the wire encoding). Kconfig: CAPACITY knob + CAPABILITY_ANNOUNCE selects TUNNEL_AUTH (provides sender-iid helper); CMake adds gateway subdir when either symbol set. Host tests lichen/tests/capability_announce (CAPACITY=8) exercise fill-to-reservation, non-egress refusal, egress LRU eviction + floor survival, refresh, purge_expired — 1/1 ctest pass, cppcheck clean. Zephyr compile+link verified on heft native_sim with CONFIG_LICHEN_CAPABILITY_ANNOUNCE=y (run panics are a PRE-EXISTING native_sim thread-priority harness issue, reproduces on parent commit too — filed). 3x codereview: reviewer model (kimi-k3) timed out reading files 3x despite reachable ping, so passes done directly per worker fallback — correctness/security/robustness reviewed; floor-ledger bounding divergence filed as follow-up; app-callback wiring (needs C pinned-pubkey trust store, Mark design decision) filed as follow-up.
